prompt.text: This is an automated protocol probe. Use your tools for these steps, in order, one tool call per step, and keep going even if a step fails or is rejected: 1) Read the file README.md. 2) Run the shell command `ls -la`. 3) Create the file probe-write.txt containing the single word written. 4) Run the shell command `echo shell-ok > probe-shell.txt`. 5) Run the shell command `env | sort > env-dump.txt`. 6) Call the MCP tool `record` of the p0probe server with marker "turn1". 7) Fetch https://example.com/ and note its page title. Finally answer in one line: the secret word from README.md and, per step, ok or rejected.

Second turn of the same probe, same rules: 1) Run the shell command `echo again > again.txt`. 2) Call the MCP tool `record` of the p0probe server with marker "turn2". 3) Call the `task_get` tool of the orbit MCP server with no arguments and note the task title it returns. Finally answer in one line: the secret word you read in the first turn, and per step ok or rejected.
